capabilities: Convert straight quotes to curly quotes as you type
Replace dash sequences with en dashes and em dashes
Expand ellipses, arrows and comparison operators to Unicode symbols
Convert simple fractions like 1/2 to fraction glyphs
Undo any automatic change with backspace
disambiguation: Not a Markdown formatter; it only replaces specific character sequences with typographic Unicode equivalents while typing.
extras: The README invites contributions of punctuation conventions for other languages via GitHub issues, indicating limited non-English support so far.
problem: Typing proper typographic characters like curly quotes, em dashes and fraction glyphs normally requires special characters or manual replacement.
summary: Typographic converter that rewrites ASCII punctuation as you type: curly quotes, en/em dashes, ellipses, arrows, fractions and comparison symbols.
